work.title: Untitled (Face with Discs) 2
work.description: Two iridescent compact discs are positioned symmetrically across the midsection of a white ground, beneath loosely drawn facial features rendered in ink. Gestural line work surrounds the face and discs, with a faint warplane silhouette visible near the upper portion and a partial mechanical element at bottom center.
work.composition: Symmetrical discs below central drawn face
keywords: loose line drawing face mixed media
